name: Greater Restoration

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: diamond dust worth 100+ GP, which the spell consumes

summary: Remove one serious affliction from a creature you touch.
text: Choose one: a level of Exhaustion, the Charmed or Petrified condition, a curse (including attunement to a cursed item), a reduction to an ability score, or a reduction to the Hit Point maximum.
